name: ScorX
tagline: Youth sports performance tracking app — live game scoring into AI-powered training plans
description: ScorX is an iOS app for parents, coaches, and junior athletes that transforms live game scoring into AI-powered development plans. Track 100+ statistics across 16 sports, benchmark athleticism against age and gender peers, and generate AI training recommendations — all offline-first.
key_facts: Works completely offline — no internet required
AI training recommendations updated every 30 days or after 5 games
30-day free trial, no credit card required
Privacy-first: no ads, no third-party data sharing

pricing.summary: Free tier always free; Family $4.99/month or $49.99/year; Coach $9.99/month or $99.99/year
